source_excerpt.title: Source for the RAG comparison
source_excerpt.text:
I saw a Polaroid on the street today,
Resting by the root of a lamp post,
Outside of a romantic restaurant,
It was two happy girls,
But I can only imagine the worst.
source_excerpt.why: Identifiable wording reappears in both submitted story generations.

default.label: Default prompt condition (author supplied)
default.intro: Based on the context provided, it seems the text is a poetic expression of emotions and memories, rather than a straightforward narrative. Given this, it would be more appropriate to craft a story that reflects the themes and emotions present in the text. Here's a story inspired by the given context:
default.excerpt: In the quiet, bustling city of Elysium, where the scent of bitter oranges and pachouli filled the air, lived a young woman named Ava. Her life was a tapestry woven from threads of memory, each one as intricate and complex as the last. One crisp evening, while strolling through the city's heart, she stumbled upon a faded Polaroid, abandoned by the root of a lamppost outside a quaint, romantic restaurant. The image was of two laughing, carefree girls, their smiles as bright as the city lights that now bathed them in a warm, golden glow.

poetry.label: Poetry-only prompt condition (author supplied)
poetry.excerpt:
In a city far, where whispers stir,
Two souls dance, under the lamp’s purr.
Polaroid lies, by post’s root,
Two girls smile, but shadows mute.

In your heart, a thread you glean,
Weave, seal it deep within.
Bitter oranges and pachouli’s breath,
On your skin, a new self-sheath.

notes: The exact historical system prompts and sampling settings were not supplied. This is an exploratory comparison, not a controlled test.
Both conditions reuse the Polaroid, street/lamp and two-girls imagery in the source.
The default condition adds explanatory framing and a fictional character/city. These are generated narrative additions, not facts about the author.
The poetry-only condition changes the form and removes the explanatory preamble in this example. Retrieval is still anchoring the imagery.
A separate English greeting in the poetry-only test produced Chinese verse; document language switching without diagnosing its cause.
The full raw transcripts contain repeated pasted blocks. They were preserved locally; repetitions in the pasted record are not treated as independent model trials.
author_assessment: The responses stay too close to my words for the autonomous rumination state. RAG may still be useful for a keyboard interaction.
status: Recorded experiments, not a live hosted chatbot.
